finding: Run B produced the same boundary-eligible Precision@K and Recall@K values as Run A, while the first boundary-eligible relevant document moved to raw rank 1 and no boundary-ineligible document was returned.
why_it_matters: The explicit tenant filter improved raw position of the allowed relevant document without changing the boundary-eligible Precision@K or Recall@K values.
metric_definition: BE-RR is the reciprocal of the raw rank of the first relevant document that is also eligible under the declared evidence boundary.
